concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-overview]] - Braintree recurring-billing availability, plan-and-Vault setup flow, and `Pending`, `Active`, `Past Due`, `Expired` and `Canceled` subscription meanings
warnings: Preserve the explicit incompatibility with Braintree Marketplace.
Keep the plan, vaulted customer payment method and subscription association as distinct setup steps.
Retain the future-date, trial, final-billing-date and proration qualifications attached to status and retry behavior.
Do not expand the page's monthly-increment scope or infer settlement finality, exact retry configuration or a Marketplace alternative.
